module: "Missions" career debug tab. Two entries: '> Reload Missions' (gameplay_missions_missions.reloadCompleteMissionSystem) and '> Make All Missions Startable' (forces startable and visible on all missions via gameplay_missions_unlocks.overrideStartable/overrideVisible then clears gameplay_rawPois).
notes: Development tool; debugOrder = 3 (same value as organizationsDebug).
